name: Mural
description: Mural is a visual collaboration workspace for team workshops, brainstorming, and aligning plans on shared canvases.
best_for: Facilitators, consultants, and cross-functional teams that run structured collaborative workshops and planning sessions.
features: Shared infinite or resizable canvases with sticky notes and diagrams
Facilitation tools including timer, voting, private mode, and summon
Workshop templates and reusable custom templates
Role-based access with view, edit, and facilitator permissions
Real-time collaboration with comments and shared links
